text:
Alex (AE): Heads up — Acme procurement sent back a security questionnaire and an acceptance checklist. They list SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM user provisioning, fine-grained RBAC, and domain ownership proofing as blockers. Also asked for pricing comparison: Hosted API vs Dedicated reserved capacity for expected 200k tokens/month. Need answers by EOD Tues.
Jamie (SE): I can own the SAML + SCIM integration doc. Quick questions: do they need just IdP-initiated or SP-initiated flows? Also what's their SCIM user/role model?
Alex (AE): They said IdP-initiated primarily, but want SP fallback. SCIM: users + groups + role mapping to our tenant roles.
Jamie (SE): Ok. Draft checklist I'm going to send to them:
- SAML: metadata exchange, assertion attributes (email, name, groups), SP-initiated optional
- SCIM: /Users, /Groups support, PATCH, bulk sync considerations
- RBAC: mapping groups -> roles, delegated admins, audit logs
- Domain proofing: TXT record or CNAME verify, org-level domain lock
I'll attach minimal SAML metadata sample and a SCIM schema snippet.
Jamie (SE): SAML example metadata snippet:
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com/acs">...
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Sam (Sales): Pricing: they want a bounded monthly bill. If they go Hosted it's pay-as-you-go; Dedicated we can offer a small reserved commit for predictable latency. Ballpark: hosted ~ $0.0005/token (gen) — for 200k tokens that's ~ $100/month. Dedicated pricing needs commit + infra fee; I'll pull comps, need expected peak RPS.
Alex (AE): Peak RPS should be small — mostly infrequent long-form generation, maybe 3 qps peak.
Priya (Security): From security questionnaire: they require SOC2 Type II, ISO27001, and evidence of network isolation for Dedicated. Also they want a diagram for key rotation and KMS integration. Can we provide an ATO-ready appendix?
Jamie (SE): We can provide SOC2/ISO cert links and a KMS integration doc. For Dedicated we can outline VPC peering and customer-managed KMS (HSM) options. I'll add rotation flow notes.
Priya (Security): They also asked for SCIM delta sync behavior and retry/backoff semantics for SCIM bulk operations — include rate limits and idempotency guidance.
Jamie (SE): Noted. For SCIM rate limits: recommend exponential backoff; we support delta tokens and incremental PATCH; we'll include sample curl commands.
Sam (Sales): Timeline check: can SEs produce the SAML/SCIM checklist, security appendix, and a 3-line pricing summary by EOD Tuesday? I'll present to procurement Wed morning.
Jamie (SE): Yes — I'll push a doc to the shared drive and paste link here when ready.
Priya (Security): I'll draft the security appendix and add cert links + network topology sketch.
SecurityBot: Automated note — linked certs updated in company bucket: https://internal.redwood/certs (access restricted). :lock: 
Alex (AE): Great, thanks team. Action items: Jamie = SAML/SCIM checklist + examples, Priya = security appendix + cert links, Sam = Hosted vs Dedicated pricing matrix + commit options. I'll follow up with Acme and schedule a 30-min POC kickoff once we have materials. :calendar:
Sam (Sales): +1. If we need to propose a short paid pilot for Dedicated, recommend 2-week burst with credits; I'll include that as an option.
Alex (AE): Perfect — target deliverables in thread by Tue 17:00 PT.
Jamie (SE): Will do. :thumbsup:
